required_unknowns: The physical nature and asymptotic continuation of dark energy are not established by finite-redshift observations.
The status of apparent time-varying dark-energy preferences depends on data combination, systematic treatment, and model family.
Electroweak vacuum lifetime is model and parameter sensitive.
required_human_review_items: Verify bibliographic metadata against publisher pages when browser access is available.
Approve data releases, likelihoods, priors, and systematic-error treatment before any execution.
Review every mapping from a fitted parameterization to a future physical continuation.
writing_constraints: Write in English and IEEE conference style.
Do not include an Acknowledgment or funding section.
Do not state or imply observed results from this proposal.
Use conditional language only where the source scope is conditional; otherwise state evidence-backed points directly.
Keep expansion fate and vacuum-decay fate in separate sections and separate conclusion labels.
